description: This is a PHP test class for the FormatWithJobCategory class, which is part of the OrangeHRM Maintenance Access Strategy module. It sets up test data, initializes the class, and verifies the getFormattedValue method returns expected results.

classes.name: FormatWithJobCategoryTest
classes.description: Test class for the FormatWithJobCategory class, extending KernelTestCase.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, loads fixture data, and creates an instance of FormatWithJobCategory.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests that getFormattedValue returns the expected job category string for a valid ID, and null for an invalid ID.
